Class OverlayImage

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.Overlay
net.murat.lovert.OverlayImage
public class OverlayImage extends Overlay
2D image overlay (e.g. a logo or watermark). Sizing modes (in priority order): 1. If drawRect is non-null, the bitmap is drawn into that exact pixel rectangle; anchor/margin/width are ignored. 2. If width > 0, the width is a ratio of the image width and the height follows the bitmap's aspect ratio (anchor + margins apply). 3. If width equal/lessThan 0, the bitmap is drawn at its native pixel size (anchor + margins apply). The rotation pivot is the center of the destination rectangle. When Overlay.flipX and/or Overlay.flipY is set, the bitmap is mirrored around the same center before rotation is applied, so the visual result is a rotated, mirrored image placed at the resolved anchor position.

      public android.graphics.Bitmap image
      The bitmap to draw. Must be non-null and not recycled at draw time.

    • width

      public float width
      Width as a ratio of the image width. Height follows the aspect ratio. Set to equal/lessThan 0 to draw at the bitmap's native pixel size.

      public android.graphics.RectF drawRect
      Optional explicit destination rectangle in pixels. When set, overrides width and the anchor/margin placement.
